caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different types of fine-tunning

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the change in WER (Word Error Rate) during fine-tuning processes labeled as "tiny full" and "base full" over consecutive epochs. The x-axis represents epochs, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis represents WER, with a linear scale ranging from 18 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The gray line with triangular markers and a dotted style corresponds to "tiny full," starting at a WER of approximately 29 at epoch 0 and gradually decreasing to a WER of around 23 by epoch 6, showing an overall downward trend. The blue line with triangular markers and a dotted style represents "base full," beginning at a WER of about 22 at epoch 0 and reducing to roughly 19 by epoch 6, also displaying a downward trend across the epochs. A legend is placed at the top right corner of the plot
